description.en: Sets, for a given event/dialogue key, whether it has already been "said" (shown) and whether talk should be locked based on that — used so a one-time line of dialogue isn't repeated.
Whether talk should be locked for this key.
Whether this dialogue has already been said.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Mark a one-time dialogue as already said
CMND_SET_TALK_LOCK_SAID("evc0039", false, true);
